answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x target and isolated to the primary region during peak settlement writes. Compliance forbids reverting the security patch, so rollback is unavailable. Circuit breaking would drop customer writes. Replica routing previously offloaded report/read traffic rather than a regional write-path fault; in-region replicas may share the same regional degradation. Capacity was historically provisioned before a peak, not mid-incident. memory_b2 is the closest match: failover restored latency in minutes with a clean shift. Peak settlement writes still imply downstream value risk if the shift is imperfect; root cause remains unconfirmed.
